point_in_time: Calendar data; no market-return future information when only used for date alignment.
known_risk: Future known exchange holidays are fine for scheduling, but labels must not use future prices.

purpose: Static/security master fields: code, name, exchange, list status, list/delist dates.
point_in_time: Partially point-in-time: list/delist dates are historical, but name/industry fields are current snapshot.
known_risk: Current industry/name can leak future classification; industry should be treated as non-point-in-time until validated.

purpose: Name-change intervals used as ST/name-history proxy.
point_in_time: Interval data with start/end/announcement dates; can be converted to daily flags.
known_risk: ST derived from name text is only a proxy; announcement timing and exchange status should be validated before training.
